Call design_get once with the three Figma links of the page as a list: https://www.figma.com/design/V1Ty9hzxZiyT32hKXNekD0/x?node-id=50-533 (desktop), https://www.figma.com/design/V1Ty9hzxZiyT32hKXNekD0/x?node-id=100-1106 (laptop), https://www.figma.com/design/V1Ty9hzxZiyT32hKXNekD0/x?node-id=100-1468 (mobile). Build the page it returns in {{CODE}}/packages/it/test/fixtures/design/host/src following every sentence of its `rules`, at each frame's width. Then call design_check and fix every row, parents before children, until its verdict is done or you have called it 8 times; design_status tells you where you stand without measuring. Never read the design image. If a tool errs, say so in one sentence and continue.

The page is one Process page of five sections: Navbar, Text Container, Container, Contact Section, Footer. The design has it three times, one frame per width: desktop 1920, laptop 1440, mobile 390; build one page that matches each frame at its width.

The page goes in the agency branch in App.tsx, a new Landing.tsx and a new landing.css; prefix every class with lp- because another fixture stylesheet is loaded globally; a node with asset and children shows that file as its background-image, cover, and adds no filter, blend, overlay or tint of its own; a node with asset and no children shows it as an img (or an inline svg for an svg) sized by its box and draws nothing else; never the Placeholder component, never a drawn svg, data url or CSS shape; no external assets except fonts from Google Fonts. The dev server stamps data-conciv-key attributes into your JSX as you save; keep them, never strip or rewrite them, and edit around them. Never read any file under a .conciv directory.
